export_pydantic_config: use ConfigExporter to export a pydantic BaseModel configuration as a dictionary with uid and default filtering
freeze_pydantic_models: recursively freeze a pydantic model hierarchy so that no attributes can be modified after instantiation
find_submodels: recursively find all submodels of a given pydantic type within a nested model or data structure
atomic_file_save: use temporary_save_path context manager to atomically write a file by saving to a temp path then renaming
check_config_consistency: use ConfigDump to check config consistency and write uid and full-uid YAML files for cache validation
